sentences.en: France seems to be swinging left - Britain to the right.
sentences.zh: 法国似乎向左转了——英国则向右。

sentences.en: He got a good grip on the bat before swinging.
They like to play on the swings in the park.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
